    public enum BomStatus { 待审核=1, 已生效=2, 淘汰=3 }

}
public class Unit { public long Id { get; set; } public string Name { get; set; } = ""; }
public class ProductCategory { public long Id { get; set; } public string Name { get; set; } = ""; }
public class Product
{
    public ProductCategory ProductCategory { get; set; } = new();
    public long Id { get; set; } public string ProductNo { get; set; } = ""; public string ProductName { get; set; } = "";
    public string TechnicalCode { get; set; } = ""; public string MaterialSpecification { get; set; } = "";
    public string MaterialGrade { get; set; } = ""; public ProductType ProductType { get; set; }
    public long BaseUnitId { get; set; } public Unit BaseUnit { get; set; } = null!;
    public decimal InventoryQuantity { get; set; } public decimal OccupyInventory { get; set; } public decimal AbnormalQuantity { get; set; }
}
public class Specification
{
    public long Id { get; set; } public string Code { get; set; } = ""; public string Name { get; set; } = "";
    public long ProductId { get; set; } public Product Product { get; set; } = null!;
    public string SpecificationText { get; set; } = "";
    public long SpecificationUnitId { get; set; } public Unit SpecificationUnit { get; set; } = null!;
    public decimal SpecificationInventoryQuantity { get; set; } public decimal OccupyInventory { get; set; } public decimal AbnormalQuantity { get; set; }
}
namespace KingZon.OLCM.Production.Shared.DataBase.Entities
{
    public class Production_MBom
    {
        public long Id { get; set; } public long? ProductId { get; set; } public Product? Product { get; set; }
        public long? ProductSpecificationId { get; set; } public ProductSpec? ProductSpecification { get; set; }
        public bool IsDeleted { get; set; } public BomStatus Status { get; set; }
    }
    public class ProductSpec
    {
        public ProductCategory? ProductCategory { get; set; }
        public long Id { get; set; } public string Code { get; set; } = ""; public string Name { get; set; } = "";
        public long ProductId { get; set; } public Product Product { get; set; } = null!;
        public string Specification { get; set; } = "";
        public long SpecificationUnitId { get; set; } public Unit SpecificationUnit { get; set; } = null!;
        public decimal SpecificationInventoryQuantity { get; set; } public decimal OccupyInventory { get; set; } public decimal AbnormalQuantity { get; set; }
    }
    public class Production_MBom_Version
    {
        public long Id { get; set; } public long MBomId { get; set; } public Production_MBom MBom { get; set; } = null!;
        public string Version { get; set; } = ""; public bool IsMain { get; set; } public bool IsDeleted { get; set; }
        public BomStatus Status { get; set; } public string Remark { get; set; } = "";
        public decimal TotalQuantity { get; set; } public long UnitConversionId { get; set; } public string UnitInfo { get; set; } = "[]";
        public List<Production_MBom_Detail> DetailList { get; set; } = new();
    }
    public class Production_MBom_Detail
    {
        public long Id { get; set; } public long VersionId { get; set; } public Production_MBom_Version BomVersion { get; set; } = null!;
        public BomDetailType DetailType { get; set; } public long DetailId { get; set; } public int Order { get; set; }
        public decimal Quantity { get; set; } public decimal Ratio { get; set; } public decimal LowerTolerance { get; set; } public decimal UpperTolerance { get; set; }
        public long UnitConversionId { get; set; } public string UnitInfo { get; set; } = "[]";
        public bool IsSubstitute { get; set; } public long? MainDetailId { get; set; } public long? MainFormulaDetailId { get; set; }
    }
}
public class Formula
{
    public long Id { get; set; } public long? ProductId { get; set; } public Product? Product { get; set; }
    public string Code { get; set; } = ""; public string Name { get; set; } = "";
}
public class FormulaVersion
{
    public long Id { get; set; } public long FormulaId { get; set; } public Formula Formula { get; set; } = null!;
    public string Version { get; set; } = ""; public decimal TotalQuantity { get; set; }
    public List<FormulaDetail> DetailList { get; set; } = new();
}
public class FormulaDetail
{
    public long Id { get; set; } public long FormulaVersionId { get; set; }
    public FormulaDetailType DetailType { get; set; } public long DetailId { get; set; }
    public decimal Quantity { get; set; } public decimal Ratio { get; set; } public decimal LowerTolerance { get; set; } public decimal UpperTolerance { get; set; }
}
public class Material
{
    public long ProductId { get; set; } public long? SpecificationId { get; set; }
    public string ProductNo { get; set; } = ""; public string ProductName { get; set; } = "";
    public string ProductTechnicalCode { get; set; } = ""; public string MaterialSpecification { get; set; } = "";
    public string ProductSpecification { get; set; } = ""; public string ProductUnit { get; set; } = "";
    public long ProductUnitId { get; set; } public ProductType ProductType { get; set; }
    public string MaterialGrade { get; set; } = ""; public string ProductCategory { get; set; } = "";
    public decimal InventoryQuantity { get; set; } public decimal OccupyInventory { get; set; } public decimal AbnormalQuantity { get; set; }
    public long ProductMainUnitId { get; set; } public string ProductMainUnit { get; set; } = "";
}
public class ProductIdDto { public long ProductId { get; set; } public long? SpecificationId { get; set; } public string IdField { get; set; } = ""; }
public class SelectionDto { public string Value { get; set; } = ""; public string Text { get; set; } = ""; public string Code { get; set; } = ""; }
public class ProductUnits { public long ProductId { get; set; } public long? SpecificationId { get; set; } public List<SelectionDto> UnitList { get; set; } = new(); }
public class ProductService
{
    public List<Material> Materials { get; } = new();
    public IQueryable<Material> GetProductList(List<int> _, List<int> __) => Materials.AsQueryable();
    public List<ProductUnits> GetProductUnitList(List<ProductIdDto> products) => products.Select(x => new ProductUnits
    { ProductId = x.ProductId, SpecificationId = x.SpecificationId, UnitList = new() { new() { Value = "1", Text = "kg", Code = "-1" } } }).ToList();
}
public class Service<T>(DbContext db) where T : class { public IQueryable<T> GetAll() => db.Set<T>(); }
public class Utils { public decimal formatDigital4(decimal value) => Math.Round(value, 4, MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero); }
public static class JsonHelper { public static JsonSerializerOptions DefaultJsonSerializerOptions { get; } = new() { PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase, PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true }; }
public class BomDb(DbContextOptions<BomDb> options) : DbContext(options)
{
    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder model)
    {
        model.Entity<Production_MBom_Version>().HasMany(x => x.DetailList).WithOne(x => x.BomVersion).HasForeignKey(x => x.VersionId);
        model.Entity<FormulaVersion>().HasMany(x => x.DetailList).WithOne().HasForeignKey(x => x.FormulaVersionId);
        model.Entity<Base_FileStorage>();
    }
}
public class Controller(ProductService productService, Service<FormulaVersion> formulaVersionService,
    Service<Production_MBom_Version> bomVersionService, Service<Base_FileStorage> fileService) : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ProductService _productService = productService;
    private readonly Service<FormulaVersion> _formulaVersionService = formulaVersionService;
    private readonly Service<Production_MBom_Version> _bomVersionService = bomVersionService;
    private readonly Service<Base_FileStorage> _fileService = fileService;
    private readonly Utils _utils = new();
    // ACTUAL_METHODS
}
